changes.ear_shape: Narrower helix/lobe silhouette, turned forward with custom cartilage shading.
changes.hair: Temple locks swept backward, crown preserved, rest bones and inverse binds updated.
changes.eyes: Smoke-gray radial irises with charcoal rims and compact pupils.
changes.face_paint: Nose tip/nostril accents, taupe lid shading and restrained lip highlights.
changes.clothing: Ivory knit, ribbed cuffs/hem/placket, pocket stitching and fold shading; original base alpha retained.

limitations: V7 edits live in the finished VRM and script, not the editable VRoid project.
Clothing lit-color detail uses an app-specific shader hook; other VRM viewers may render it differently.
Broad fringe, sparse front locks, eyelid/cheek nuance, shoes and clothing drape still differ from the approved reference.
No general arbitrary-pose hair or cloth collision solver.
Sustained whole-app memory/thermal/multitasking performance not benchmarked.
